title: Listening Drill — Street tree records
description: Interview. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Street tree records
sections.transcript:
HOST: You work on building a street tree register. What got your team started? People often think projects like yours begin with a large grant.

GUEST: Ours started with old photographs. At the time our biggest obstacle was missing addresses. We had to change the plan before we could make proper progress.

HOST: What surprised you once you started getting results?

GUEST: We discovered repeated planting. It helped us improve tree identification. That wasn't a goal we had written into the original proposal.

HOST: And what happens next?

GUEST: We'll ask residents to check the draft map. Then we'll decide whether to expand.
